title: Current and Monsoon
author: Casper Reyes
blurb: Felix Sterling, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
